transcript.text: microwve plate wont go round anymore, food hot on one side cold on other. still heats tho

The uneven heating is a direct result of the turntable not rotating. Since it still heats, this is almost certainly a mechanical issue with the turntable system rather than the magnetron. Please lift the glass plate out and check two things:
1. Is anything blocking the rollers or catching on the side of the cavity?
2. Look at the small plastic piece in the centre (the coupler) - is it cracked, or are the prongs broken off? Once you've checked that, put the plate back on correctly and let me know what you found.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
ok checked. nothing stuck under the roller ring, wheels turn fine. the little plastic piece in the middle has a crack in it and the hole looks kinda rounded. plate sits on it but wobbles

That cracked and rounded plastic piece is the turntable coupler. It’s designed to slot onto a motor shaft underneath; once it cracks or rounds over, it can no longer grip the plate properly, which explains why it won’t rotate and your food heats unevenly. To fix this, you’ll need to replace that small plastic coupler (the glass tray is fine if it’s not cracked). To make sure you get the exact right one, could you please check the model number on the rating plate? It’s usually inside the door frame or on the back of the unit.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
its a Sharp R272WM, found it on the label at the back

[Heading: Likely cause: turntable coupler]
The cracked and rounded plastic piece in the centre is most likely the turntable coupler. It’s a small, inexpensive part that slots onto the motor shaft to drive the plate; once it breaks or rounds over, the motor can’t grip it anymore. I couldn't find a confirmed match for the Sharp R272WM in my current parts database, so I recommend checking the manufacturer's official spares page or contacting an authorised service centre with your model number. They will be able to supply the exact coupler you need. Once you have the replacement, simply unplug the microwave, lift out the glass plate, remove the broken coupler from the shaft, and slot the new one in before replacing the tray.
